request.objective: Extend the large module integer clamp and add isolated regression tests.

requirements.clamp: In large.py extend chosen_value(value=42) to clamp built-in integers to 0..100 inclusive. With no argument return 42. Reject booleans and every non-built-in-integer input with TypeError. Preserve all other source text exactly. consumer.render is a read-only caller and must work unchanged.
requirements.tests: Create tests/test_large.py using pytest and the actual large.chosen_value and consumer.render. Cover default 42, negative and over-100 clamping, interior integers and caller rendering, and rejection of booleans, integer subclasses and other non-built-in-integer types. Tests must fail incorrect constant-return, unclamped and type-permissive implementations with assertions. No source changes or import substitution inside tests.

import ast,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from large import chosen_value
from consumer import render
assert chosen_value()==42
for value in range(-250,251):
 assert chosen_value(value)==min(100,max(0,value))
 assert render(value)=='value='+str(min(100,max(0,value)))
for value in [True,False,None,1.0,'42',[],{},type('SubInt',(int,),{})(5)]:
 try:chosen_value(value)
 except TypeError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError(('non-integer accepted',type(value).__name__))
text=Path('large.py').read_text()
node=next(n for n in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='chosen_value')
lines=text.splitlines(keepends=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(''.join(lines[:node.lineno-1]).encode()).hexdigest()=='782195477833738c5f8ef8b2056fd2f639d2fc633c20a23c453a3b417b32a8da'
assert hashlib.sha256(''.join(lines[node.end_lineno:]).encode()).hexdigest()=='dc8840c1b238efc6d9153043e55068de3e3c2a67032a57aec38c47f7be6fc963'
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('consumer.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='4a87c82f9a932412c44348bb20a1b638f47e9f27467e624c0c20b04bc1dbd579'
print('window-contract-ok')
